action.name: edit_ir
action.note: unroll the dot-product loop by 16 (dwordx4 vector loads, one dwordx16 scalar load), original accumulation order

notes.text: amdclang keeps one global_load + one s_load + a full s_waitcnt per element, so the loop is bound by memory latency. Unrolling with wide loads (dwordx4 vector, dwordx16 scalar) and keeping the fmac order gives bit-identical results: x4 2.29x, x8 2.54x, x16 2.70x. Tuples must start on even VGPRs / multiple-of-4 SGPRs (llvm-mc rejected v[5:8]).
